summary: Add a manual-dispatch macOS run of the seat-priority hog load test to the Performance workflow, and keep its test binary.

replay.detail: Performance test addition only; no projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: No writer, checkpoint, retention or authority changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing jobs are unchanged; the new job runs only on manual dispatch and continues on error.

downtime.detail: No service or runner deployment is introduced.

manual.detail: Nothing manual is required; the job runs only when someone dispatches the workflow.

recovery.detail: Reverting removes the perf-load-hog-macos job; nothing stored changes.
